comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Feature 0 is a comment-level style judgment: a rebuttal that is mainly abstract logical reasoning and has no named real-world example or analogy. Feature 1 is the presence of a named external program or location in a comment's argument. They share only the source column. Feature 0 requires abstract reasoning and excludes any named example or analogy. Feature 1 does not require rebuttal or abstract reasoning, covers only programs and locations, and does not cover analogies or other named examples. A comment can be 1 on both, or 0 on both, so they are not the same extraction function.
